name: Courtney Walter
current_role: Chief of Staff, U.S. Department of Labor (since May 2026)
summary: Courtney Walter became chief of staff of the Labor Department on May 1, 2026, when Acting Secretary Keith Sonderling named his senior team after Lori Chavez-DeRemer resigned. She had been senior counselor to the secretary since March 2025, and in the first Trump administration held several posts at the department, including senior counsel in the Office of the Solicitor, with private labor and employment practice in between.
